question: The Nicene Creed describes the Church with four attributes. Which set correctly lists all four?

teaching.title: The Four Marks of the Church
teaching.body: The Nicene-Constantinopolitan Creed (381 AD) confesses belief in 'one, holy, catholic, and apostolic Church.' These four marks are not just organizational features but theological claims: unity flows from one Lord, one faith, one baptism; holiness from Christ who sanctifies her; catholicity from her universal mission; and apostolicity from her foundation on the apostles and their successors.
